## Genomics Pipelines   ·   Cloud Data Platforms   ·   Antibody AI

::: {.about-lead}
I help biotech and regulated-health teams turn complex sequencing and scientific data into pipelines and cloud platforms they can trust. Over 10+ years across biotech, consulting, NIH and FDA, I have worked across the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and quality control to analytics and delivery.

With a background in engineering and computational science, I work comfortably with both the scientists asking the questions and the engineers building the platforms that answer them.
:::

## What I do

::: {.about-grid}

::: {.about-card}
<div class="about-label">Solution architecture</div>

- End-to-end genomics data platforms and pipelines
- From ingestion and QC to analytics and delivery
- ETL/ELT and workflow orchestration

<div class="about-pills"><span>Nextflow</span><span>Snakemake</span><span>Databricks</span></div>
:::

::: {.about-card}
<div class="about-label">Cloud</div>

- Storage, compute and pipelines on AWS and Azure
- Reproducible deployment with containers and CI/CD

<div class="about-pills"><span>AWS S3</span><span>AWS EC2</span><span>Azure Data Factory</span><span>Azure Databricks</span><span>Docker</span></div>
:::

::: {.about-card}
<div class="about-label">Applied AI/ML</div>

- Model training, evaluation and tracking
- Protein language models such as ESM-2 on antibody data

<div class="about-pills"><span>PyTorch</span><span>TensorFlow</span><span>MLflow</span></div>
:::

::: {.about-card}
<div class="about-label">Life sciences</div>

- Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq
- Antibody repertoires and multi-omics
- Regulated NIH/FDA data environments

<div class="about-pills"><span>DESeq2</span><span>Seurat</span><span>CellRanger</span><span>nf-core/airrflow</span></div>
:::

:::

## Selected experience

::: {.about-exp}
**Senior Bioinformatics Scientist**, Argentys Informatics

Reproducible pipeline for antibody repertoire analysis on the Observed Antibody Space (2B+ sequences, about 3 TB), producing model-ready data for protein language models.
:::

::: {.about-exp}
**Bioinformatics Scientist (contract)**, Twist Bioscience

Zero-shot antibody fitness and developability inference with repeatable evaluation.
:::

::: {.about-exp}
**Senior Bioinformatics Scientist (contract)**, FDA

Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq pipelines.
:::

Full history on my [CV](cv.qmd).
